subject: Is your 3D data pipeline slowing model development?
text:
Hi Asma, 

I’ve noticed that many of the to ML teams I speak to in the physical AI space find 3D cuboid labeling to be a big bottleneck in their pipeline. 

As point cloud datasets grow, drawing cuboids frame by frame turns into a slow, expensive grind and it’s hard to scale. 

So we’re hosting a short, 20-minute masterclass on the 19th of Feb to walk through how teams are moving away from manual-first 3D annotation and into autolabeling workflows, where models generate cuboids and humans focus on review, fixes, and edge cases.
